predictable_extreme_weight_stress.interpretation: Predictable extreme weighting did not break V3 replay/numerical invariants, but it materially changed the estimand/information clock and prevented resolution by 220 blocks in every tested campaign. Raw block count is therefore not an adequate proxy for planned-exposure information.

postselection_reporting_frontier.all_pairs_union_portfolio: Precommit pair masses pi_k; multiply each candidate pair's two channel alphas by pi_k. This buys simultaneous coverage of every candidate pair and therefore arbitrary same-history pair selection, but was costly in the 9-pair V3 stress.

public_evidence.title: Post-selection inference for e-value based confidence intervals
public_evidence.authors: Ziyu Xu, Ruodu Wang, Aaditya Ramdas
public_evidence.relevance: e-BY controls FCR for selected e-CIs under arbitrary dependence/selection and applies in sequential settings; FCR is not the desired probability that both bounds in one selected pair cover.

public_evidence.title: Confidence Intervals for Selected Parameters
public_evidence.authors: Yoav Benjamini, Yotam Hechtlinger, Philip B. Stark
public_evidence.relevance: Defines simultaneous-over-selected (SoS) error and shows selection-rule-aware intervals can beat generic simultaneous insurance in specific independent/top-k settings; those assumptions do not directly cover adaptive V3 allocation-pair selection.

postselection_reporting_frontier.new_hypothesis: A selection-rule-aware SoS construction specialized to choosing the fastest-safe allocation pair may recover power relative to all-pairs union protection, but it must preserve sequential/optional-stopping validity and cannot be inferred from FCR results alone.

measurement_validity_rules: Report the weighted information clock (for example cumulative planned exposure weight) alongside raw block count; the two can diverge sharply under predictable block-size adaptation.
Predictable weighting is a validity condition, not a promise of resolution or equivalence of equal-process and exposure-weighted estimands.

For post-data reporting-policy selection, name the target error criterion explicitly: FCR, simultaneous-over-selected error, and simultaneous coverage of all candidate reports are not interchangeable.
Selection-rule-aware intervals may legitimately outperform universal simultaneous insurance only when their selection assumptions and sequential filtration match the deployed reporting rule.
Keep decision-IUT, numerical reporting and reporting-policy selection as separate layers with separate guarantees.
scope_guards: Extreme-weight stress is synthetic and does not imply production non-resolution; it establishes a tested numerical/estimand boundary only.
Public SoS results cited here use specialized selection/independence structures and are hypotheses for adaptation, not evidence that a V3 selective-report method is already valid.
The same-history postselection costs are finite nine-allocation stress results, not lower bounds on all possible valid methods.
Exact checked-out execution of persisted V3 validators remains an operational verification gap; current numerical execution used an executable transcription of the frozen V3 source.

frontier.action: Derive a sequential selection-rule-aware simultaneous-over-selected guarantee for the exact rule 'choose one reporting allocation pair from a predeclared finite grid after observing V3 evidence'; determine whether conditional/closed-test/e-value structure can beat all-pairs union protection while still guaranteeing both selected bounds cover with probability >=.95.
Run persisted validators in a checked-out repository runtime importing the exact V3/journal modules and require stored campaign digests plus zero replay/decision/snapshot mismatches.

Extend predictable-weight stress to longer horizons and report cumulative W_t, effective score variance and resolution as separate functions of raw block count; do not label W_t an iid effective sample size.
Stress adversarial but predictable B_t rules with different score-rate transitions and near-zero weights while preserving journal replay and frozen-weight provenance.
Continue same-fingerprint repeated-inference trace search and measure raw->token->score->paired-sign propagation without pseudoreplication.

frontier.exact_next_action: Formalize the selected-report event for a finite allocation grid and compare three guarantees on the same V3 e-process family: all-pairs simultaneous union protection, e-BY/FCR (kept distinct), and any selection-rule-aware SoS construction whose assumptions can be verified under optional stopping.
